description: Returns one AnimatedWebs template by slug: description, stack, tags, access level, tools it works with, licence note, demo and preview URLs, views, saves and likes, and with include_prompt true the full build prompt as Markdown. Use it to inspect a template found with search_catalog and, once the user has chosen, to get the prompt and build it in the current project; use open_builder instead to hand the prompt to Lovable, v0 or Bolt. Without include_prompt it never spends a credit and changes nothing. With include_prompt: free templates work on any signed-in account; a Pro template is included with Pro and Lifetime, otherwise the first fetch spends one Prompt Pack credit (later fetches of that slug are free) and an account with no credits gets an error with the pack link. New Pro prompts have a fair-use cap (20 per 10 minutes, 60 a day, 200 a week, shared with open_builder) that never blocks a prompt already opened today. Free-plan accounts may get a short upgrade note as a second text block. Unknown slugs return an error. Example: {"slug":"aurora-site","include_prompt":true}.

include_prompt.description: true adds prompt (the build prompt as Markdown) after the access check above. Default false: details only, nothing spent.

slug.description: Template slug exactly as returned by search_catalog (lowercase, hyphenated), e.g. 'aurora-site'.

name: get_template

demo.description: Live demo URL, null when no demo exists

license.description: Licence summary for this access level

preview.description: Preview image URL, null when none

prompt.description: Only with include_prompt: Markdown with title, description, stack, then the build prompt

techniques.description: 3D / WebGL technique facets (threejs, particles, shaders, 3d-objects, scroll-3d, simulators); empty when the template is not 3D

views.description: All-time page and demo views (refreshed every few hours)

worksWith.description: AI builders and tools the prompt was tested with

title: Get an AnimatedWebs template
